Photo stop near Narita → Tanashichō can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 10 km this is Jura Crest Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 29.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 1228 m come off over 18 km at around 6.1%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

jura-crest-scenic-road.story: 94 km one way from Nyon - plan on about 1 h 31 of riding. The stops in between: St Cergue, Col de la Givrine, Le Brassus and Sainte Croix. The highest point is about 1,250 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
